subject: ist-s-algn
title: IST.S.ALGN.------ALT.F.
description: Chart on book p. 93 (WAM-35). IST-S-ALGN (isolated systematic alignment) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; ALT-F (alternative functionalism) is the partner. From the subject: INFO-DY. From INFO-DY: INTR (interpretation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of", and MT-INTR (multiple interpretation). From INTR: MOT-DY. From MOT-DY: SOC-RT (social reality). From SOC-RT: POL-P (political policies). From POL-P: INDIV-TD (individual tendencies). From MT-INTR: ACC-DY (accelerated dynamics) and PROG-SIGN (progressional significance). From PROG-SIGN: RE-ST (restructuralism), with the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion".
